# colada-db

> Local-first client database for the browser: a normalized reactive entity
> store (synchronous reads from an in-memory projection) over pluggable
> write-behind durability engines (in-memory, IndexedDB, OPFS SQLite in a
> worker). Designed AI-first (ADR-007): origin-attributed writes
> (`WriteOrigin`), a pre-apply policy gate (`useGate`), a capped queryable
> history store (`enableHistory`), and a machine-legible schema export
> (`exportSchema`). Those four are the committed Stage-2 cornerstone and all
> four ARE in this build, shipped 2026-07-19 and exported from the package
> root. Framework-agnostic core; adapters consume a two-function subscription
> boundary; Vue gets a privileged direct-ref path.

Status: pre-release, unpublished. Extracted 2026-07-19 from the shipped
`pinia-colada-plugin-normalizer` (npm, 0.3.0), which becomes its Vue adapter.

What is NOT in this build, stated plainly: no sync. The three-method
`SyncAdapter` contract is specified (ADR-006, still `Proposed`) and the
durability layer was built to accept it, but no adapter ships and nothing
sync-related is exported. `packages/mcp` (the read-only MCP agent surface)
lives in this repo and runs, but is not published to npm.

## Read first
- AGENTS.md: how to work on this repo — verify commands, extraction chip state, reading order
- docs/adr/: the constitution (ADR-003 memory projection · 004 evict-vs-remove · 005 sync posture · 006 SyncAdapter contract · 007 AI-first cornerstone · 008 boring core, radical edges)
- docs/BATTLE-TESTED.md: what was adopted from 12+ production systems, what failures are structurally prevented, where the contract leads the field
- CHANGELOG.md: session-by-session history with verification evidence

## Source map (src/)
- store.ts: EntityStore — reactive normalized entity graph; set/replace/setMany/update/remove/evict, refcounts + gc(), subscribe
- normalize.ts: normalize()/denormalize() — extract entities from payloads into the store; resolve refs back with structural sharing
- transactions.ts: createOptimisticUpdates(store) — optimistic transactions, clear-and-replay rollback, concurrency-correct commit
- boundary.ts: createStoreBoundary(store) — framework-adapter contract (subscribe + version snapshot + phantom-safe reads)
- persist.ts: enablePersistence(store, {engine}) — boot hydration + debounced write-behind + requestDurableStorage()
- engines/: memory.ts · idb.ts (Safari-hang armor) · sqlite.ts + sqlite-core/protocol + ../sqlite-worker.ts (OPFS, no COOP/COEP)
- pagination.ts: cursor/offset/relay merge recipes
- matcher.ts: serializable matcher AST (ADR-009) — parseMatcher/evaluateMatcher/classifyFilter/M builder; fails closed, fields are flat own-property names
- matcher-view.ts: createMatcherView — live filtered membership views, two-tier (ADR-010)
- history.ts: enableHistory — capped field-level change log with purge-on-remove erasure
- schema.ts: exportSchema — the entity registry as plain JSON (the MCP resource)
- transactions.ts also carries the policy gate (useGate, PolicyVetoError)
- coalesce.ts: createCoalescer — debounced batch flush shared by persist and matcher views
- engine-conformance.ts: the shared StorageEngine contract kit every engine is run against
- types.ts: EntityStore/StorageEngine/EntityEvent contracts, defineEntity, EntityRegistry (module augmentation)

## Also here
- packages/mcp: read-only MCP agent surface (ADR-011). ZERO write tools registered; per-type allowlist; results marked untrusted. In-repo, not on npm.

## Verify
CI=true pnpm -r test · pnpm -r typecheck · pnpm -r build · pnpm -r lint (all must be green)
CI=true pnpm test:browser — real Chromium, real IndexedDB + real OPFS across a reload; the only lane where storage is real
pnpm check:publish-surface · pnpm check:api-report · pnpm check:pack-manifest — the three publish gates (ADR-022 lines 2 and 3)
